long_biography.plain_text:
Huiskes-Kokkeler was already a broad mobility business when Van der Straaten acquired it from Dealer Groep Pon in 2005. He brought prior experience as owner of Century in Groningen. The new operation combined Volkswagen Group dealerships in the eastern Netherlands with body repair, vehicle rental, leasing and commercial-vehicle services.

Van der Straaten Automotive Beheer sat above those operating companies as the ownership platform. Aftersales and related services extended the group's income beyond new-car retailing, making it a regional mobility network rather than a collection of showrooms. Its portfolio later narrowed when Volkswagen Pon Financial Services acquired all shares in the leasing subsidiary. He remains director of the Blaricum holding company.
